[[File:ChiCho-DB.png|thumb|right|150px|Chairman Chi Cho of Pantora]]
The title of '''Chairman''' was given to the permanent or long-term president of a company, committee or other organization. It was notably the highest rank one could obtain in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this position was held by [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] and had previously been held by a member of the [[Tonith family]].

Chairman was also the title used by the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], as leader of the [[Utapaun Committee/Legends|Utapaun Committee]]. [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]], the elected head of the moon of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora's]] government ([[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|The Pantoran Assembly]]), was also addressed as Chairman.

Chairman was also the title of the leader of the [[Vorzydiak]]s on [[Vorzyd IV]], which was [[Port]] during [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi Wan Kenobi's]] mission in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was also called Chairman by [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]s at one point when he owned [[Sarnus Refinery]] in [[45 ABY]].
